q.x: The updated NDC raised the target to 45% by 2030; the first NDC had 33–35%.

q.s: After coal (including lignite), which source has the largest share in India's installed power capacity?
q.x: Solar (about 29%) is second after coal (about 42%), followed by wind and large hydro.

q.s: Which one of the following statements about natural gas is correct?
o: It is the most polluting fossil fuel
It is the main constituent of LPG
q.x: Natural gas is mostly methane and is the cleanest fossil fuel; LPG is mainly propane and butane.

q.s: Which is the largest coal-producing State of India?
q.x: Odisha (about 24% in 2023-24) leads; India is the world's second-largest coal producer.

q.s: The power available to a wind turbine varies with which power of the wind speed?
q.x: Wind power varies with the cube of wind speed.

q.s: According to the Betz limit, the maximum share of the wind's kinetic energy a turbine can capture is about:
q.x: The Betz limit is 16/27, about 59.3%.

q.s: A species, such as the tiger, whose effect on its ecosystem is disproportionately large compared to its numbers is called a:
q.x: Top predators like the tiger are keystone species; the tiger is also a flagship and umbrella species.

q.s: Which one of the following statements about the IUCN is correct?
o: It is a specialised agency of the UN
Its headquarters is at Gland, Switzerland
It publishes the Living Planet Report
q.x: The IUCN (1948) is a union of governments and NGOs at Gland; 1961 is WWF's founding year and WWF publishes the Living Planet Report.

q.s: India's first Heat Action Plan was prepared in 2013 by:
q.x: Ahmedabad prepared the first Heat Action Plan; NDMA issued guidelines in 2016.

q.s: Which State accounts for the largest share (over 23 per cent) of India's desertified land?
q.x: Rajasthan has the largest share of desertified land.

q.s: Under the Wildlife (Protection) Act, 1972, the Chief Wildlife Warden may permit the capture or killing of a protected animal if it:
o: Has strayed out of a sanctuary
Has become dangerous to human life
q.x: Section 11 allows it when the animal endangers human life or is diseased beyond recovery.

q.s: Which of the following is NOT a feature of the Wildlife (Protection) Amendment Act, 2022?
o: Reduction of schedules from six to four
Transfer of the power to declare vermin to the States
Power to regulate invasive alien species
q.x: The power to declare vermin under Section 62 stays with the Central Government.

q.s: The 13th Conference of Parties of the Convention on Migratory Species (CMS COP13) was held in 2020 at:
q.x: CMS COP13 at Gandhinagar listed the Great Indian Bustard, Asian elephant and Bengal florican in Appendix I.

q.s: India has hosted the CITES Conference of Parties only once, in 1981, at:
q.x: CITES CoP3 was held at New Delhi in 1981.

q.s: The '30 by 30' goal of the Kunming–Montreal Global Biodiversity Framework aims to conserve by 2030:
q.x: Target 3 seeks to conserve 30% of land and 30% of oceans by 2030.

q.s: Which Indian Ramsar sites are at present on the Montreux Record?
q.x: Keoladeo and Loktak are on the Montreux Record; Chilika was removed in 2002.

q.s: The chairperson of a State Pollution Control Board is nominated by the:
q.x: The State Government nominates SPCB members; the APPCB is headquartered at Vijayawada.

q.s: The headquarters of the National Biodiversity Authority, set up in 2003, is at:
q.x: The NBA is at Chennai; it was created under the Biological Diversity Act, 2002.

q.s: The Global E-waste Monitor is published jointly by the ITU and:
q.x: The ITU and UNITAR publish it; the 2024 edition found only about 22% of e-waste was formally recycled.

q.s: India's position among the world's largest generators of e-waste is:
q.x: India is third, after China and the USA.

q.s: The Comprehensive Environmental Pollution Index (CEPI) was developed in 2009 by the CPCB together with:
q.x: CEPI was developed with IIT Delhi; a score of 70 or above marks a critically polluted cluster.

The AR7 cycle began before AR6 was completed
The Synthesis Report of AR6 was released in March 2023

Adaptation Fund – Share of CDM proceeds

Years lived in full health only

o: International Institute for Population Sciences, Mumbai

q.x: NFHS-5 added BP and diabetes checks but dropped the HIV test.

q.x: It is named after Sungai Nipah in Malaysia, where it was found in 1998.

q.x: The target is 25,000 Kendras by March 2027; there were 17,990 in December 2025.

q.s: The 'Saras' light transport aircraft was developed by:
q.x: Saras was developed by CSIR-NAL, Bengaluru.

q.s: Safe-harbour protection for intermediaries under the Information Technology Act, 2000 is provided by Section:
q.x: Section 79 gives safe harbour; Section 87 is the rule-making power, and Section 69A deals with blocking.

q.x: Bain Capital's 18% stake is in Manappuram Finance; Blackstone agreed to take 9.99% of Federal Bank.

q.s: The United States withdrew India's Generalised System of Preferences (GSP) benefits in June 2019 under President:
q.x: GSP was withdrawn in June 2019 during Donald Trump's first term.

q.s: NTPC's green hydrogen hub, highlighted in 2025, is being developed in which State?
q.x: NTPC's green hydrogen hub is at Pudimadaka near Visakhapatnam, Andhra Pradesh.

q.s: Which one of the following statements about the World Intellectual Property Organization (WIPO) is correct?
o: The WIPO Convention was signed at Paris in 1883
India is not a member of WIPO
It became a UN specialised agency in 1945

q.s: The 14th Ministerial Conference of the WTO (MC14), held in March 2026, took place at:

q.s: The India Semiconductor Mission (2021) functions under the:
o: Ministry of Electronics and Information Technology
q.x: ISM is under MeitY.

q.s: The Udayagiri Caves of Madhya Pradesh, added to India's Tentative List of World Heritage, belong to which period?
q.x: The Udayagiri caves near Vidisha are Gupta-period rock-cut shrines.

q.s: India has proposed the transnational World Heritage nomination 'Sites of Satyagraha' together with:
q.x: The serial nomination links Gandhian satyagraha sites in India and South Africa.

q.s: The Palestine Liberation Organization declared Palestinian statehood in 1988 at:
q.x: The declaration was made at Algiers; Hamas has run Gaza since 2007.

q.s: The US 'Lindsey O. Graham Sanctioning Russia and Iran Act, 2026' extends sanctions on Iran up to the year:

q.s: Which of the following port–country pairs is NOT correctly matched?
q.x: Sohar is in Oman; Chabahar is India's port project in Iran and Gwadar is part of CPEC.

q.s: Which of the following countries is NOT a member of the European Free Trade Association (EFTA), with which India signed the TEPA?
q.x: EFTA is Iceland, Liechtenstein, Norway and Switzerland; Sweden is in the EU.

q.s: India aims to raise its nuclear power capacity by 2047 to:
q.x: The target is 100 GW by 2047, from about 9 GW now.

q.s: The final (third) stage of Homi Bhabha's three-stage nuclear programme aims at using which fuel?
q.x: The third stage uses thorium, of which India has large reserves; Russia supplies Kudankulam's fuel.

q.s: The military exercise 'Harimau Shakti' is held between India and:
q.x: Harimau Shakti is with the Malaysian Army; Khanjar is with Kyrgyzstan and Cyclone with Egypt.

q.s: Which of the following exercise–partner country pairs is NOT correctly matched?
q.x: Harimau Shakti is with Malaysia.

q.s: 'Badri', whose first test-tube calf was produced in 2026, is an indigenous hill cattle breed of:
q.x: Badri is a hardy Himalayan breed of Uttarakhand; ICAR–NDRI used Sahiwal surrogate cows.

q.s: Which one of the following statements about INS Vikrant is correct?
o: It was built at Mazagon Dock, Mumbai
It is a CATOBAR aircraft carrier
It is a STOBAR aircraft carrier

q.s: The Next Generation Offshore Patrol Vessels (NGOPVs) of the Indian Navy are being built by Goa Shipyard Ltd and:

q.s: ICGV 181030, India's first high-oleic groundnut variety, was developed by:
q.x: It was developed by ICRISAT, Patancheru.

q.x: Dr. N. Kalaiselvi heads CSIR.

q.x: Radio Sangam is the Army's first community radio near the LoC; 'Bhairav' is a drone-centric combat force.

q.s: AdFalciVax, India's first indigenous multi-stage malaria vaccine candidate, was developed by:
q.x: ICMR-RMRC Bhubaneswar developed it using Lactococcus lactis; it targets Plasmodium falciparum and is stable at room temperature.

q.s: The first Vande Bharat Express (Train 18) ran between New Delhi and:
q.x: The first service (2019) was New Delhi–Varanasi; it was built at ICF Chennai.

q.x: It was designed by RDSO and built at ICF Chennai; its operating speed is up to 160 km/h.

q.x: It forms in the stratosphere, where polar stratospheric clouds provide surfaces for ozone-destroying reactions.

q.x: The AQI uses PM10, PM2.5, NO2, SO2, CO, O3, NH3 and lead; methane is not included.

q.s: 'Limnonectes motijheel', a new fanged frog with underground nests described in 2026, was found in which tiger reserve?
q.x: It was found in Namdapha Tiger Reserve, Arunachal Pradesh.

q.s: National Geo-Heritage Sites in India are declared by the Geological Survey of India, which was set up in:
q.x: The GSI was established in 1851; the Yana Caves near Gokarna are in the Western Ghats.

q.s: Which of the following GI product–State pairs is NOT correctly matched?
q.x: Nagauri Ashwagandha is from Rajasthan (GI in 2025).

q.s: Manas National Park, a World Heritage Site since 1985, is located in:
q.x: Manas is in Assam; Kamjong district is in Manipur.

q.x: Barda Wildlife Sanctuary is being developed as the second home; Gir lies in the Junagadh–Gir Somnath area.

o: India has exited WHO's 'High Burden to High Impact' group
India has not set any elimination target
MERA India is led by the NVBDCP

o: Global Peace Index – Institute for Economics and Peace
Energy Transition Index – World Economic Forum
q.x: The Global Passport Index is by Global Citizen Solutions.

q.x: Bad Bunny won Album of the Year; Kendrick Lamar led the nominations.

An ordinance cannot be withdrawn once issued

The Speaker has a casting vote on the resolution
It is passed by a majority of members present and voting

q.s: Under the Citizenship (Amendment) Act, 2019, the cut-off date for entry into India of the six specified minorities is:

o: India is a party to the 1951 Refugee Convention but not the 1967 Protocol
India has signed neither the 1951 Refugee Convention nor its 1967 Protocol

The CAA 2019 covers Sri Lankan Tamils
